about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers climbing and sectional dismantling, crane and bucket work, stump and debris clearance. We work out of Newport and the towns around it.

reviews.author: Lynette Fischer
reviews.text: I had two extremely tall pines around Mandy Farms area close to my house that string winds could take down. I phoned Steller Tree Service; I had an in person quote in 3 days. The team showed up early set up their machines and equipment. They worked efficiently, chipped the wood and even raked up the clippings. They were done before lunchtime. I have t Say the honesty, talent and professionalism you should call Steller Tree Service.

reviews.author: Ben Sumners
reviews.text: I had a dead tree finally crack at the base. We have gale warnings for next 36 hours. I called after normal work hours and he showed up because he knew my family needed the security of that tree not harming us. We thank you so much!

reviews.author: Duke Capel
reviews.text: Professional is an understatement. Eric and his crew did a great job removing three pine trees and two black gums from my yard near the marsh. They do the work in a timely manner and clean up after themselves. Settles Tree Service is a well oiled machine that you can count on.

reviews.author: Luann Rottmann
reviews.text: We are super impressed with Settles! They took down two trees for us, cleaned up and were very respectful of our property.

reviews.author: Elana McClure
reviews.text: Eric and crew showed up on time and did a great job pruning our trees and grinding some stumps. They cleaned up all the debris and left our yard looking great! We will definitely use them again. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Paula Vas
reviews.text: Settles Tree Service gets two thumbs up! We’re very pleased with the work Eric did for us working on two large trees. He also provided options for us and went above and beyond for customer satisfaction. Will definitely use them again if needed. - Emerald Isle

reviews.author: brooke Prescott
reviews.text: They removed two large trees and did an excellent job cleaning up. I couldn’t believe it only took them a little over an hour. They were very careful around my landscaping. Couldn’t be more happy with the service.

reviews.author: Karlee Thomas
reviews.text: Settle Tree Service did a great job removing a dying tree from my property. The service was professional, competitively priced, and they removed the tree quickly while taking care of my property. Would highly recommend them!!

reviews.author: Stephen Rohrer
reviews.text: Settle is very fair on pricing, on time, fast and dependable. Easy to work with, quick turn around on a quote, and got on schedule.

reviews.author: Robert Rose
reviews.text: I had a 60 year old pine tree with roots that broke my water pipe to my house. Settles Tree Service showed up quickly, took down the tree, and removed the stump and roots until we could locate the pipes and repair the leak. Their speed, effectiveness and clean up was really great service. They have removed other trees for me, and I would recommend them to anyone looking to have tree work done.

reviews.author: lavonne stone
reviews.text: The crew was fast, efficient, and very respectful of our property. After removing the trees, they ground the stumps, leveled and raked the ground. We are very happy with their work!

reviews.author: matt brown
reviews.text: Let me start with Eric and his guys are a rarity for the beach services. They actually show up when scheduled and do a great job. They trimmed my live oaks and palm trees. Nice hard working guys. I recommend highly.

reviews.author: Sarah DeLuzio
reviews.text: Such professional service! Great communication. Cleaned up behind their work and even shut the dog gate, which most forget. We had 4 trees taken out at a very reasonable price with thorough stump grinding, raking, and tidy wood stacking. Super nice owners! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Cody Scott
reviews.text: Settle quoted my project and showed up when they said they would. Heather provided me a start date and the crew arrived promptly on that day and worked very hard to cut 4 trees around my house and chain link fence. I am happy to say not one piece of my chain link fence was damaged. I was impressed with their arsenal of equipment and all of their safety measures. I cannot say enough good things about Settle Tree Service. You will not be disappointed in using this company.

reviews.author: Joe Munagorri
reviews.text: They came out, assessed the job, and quickly took out the required trees safely and professionally. Would recommend Settle Tree Service for any tree services you may have. Great job! Thank you.

reviews.author: Jackie Powers
reviews.text: Excellent job! Just moved here and need a fence put in but needed trees removed. Called them got a quote for a reasonable amount a Date to get the work done and what time. They showed up on time worked well the job was done in 4 hrs. Doesn't even look like we had trees there. They cleaned up and everything looks Fabulous. Would reccomend them and will use them again!!

reviews.author: Betsy Fincham
reviews.text: Great company to do business with. And so nice. Eric and his team were the only ones willing to climb the live oaks for trimming. They did a great job! We will be calling them back when we need it done again. Thanks!!

reviews.author: Amanda Owens
reviews.text: UPDATE 5/11/23: Called to request an estimate to grind more azalea stumps in February 2023. Showed up the next day for quote and completed the work the next day! Feb 2022: Came out quickly to provide estimate to remove a tree where the driveway was poured around it when the house was built and some azalea bush stumps in the front yard. Was on time the day of removal and took extra care to secure cut tree limbs as not to break the driveway. They even removed some additional azalea bush stumps in the backyard as a last minute request. They smoothed soil where azaleas were and cleaned up quickly. Great job. Will definitely use again.

reviews.author: tina caudell
reviews.text: Called Settle Tree Services, great guys! Came next day to do the trimming on a huge pine tree damaged during Florence. Other companies put us off for months! It didn’t take long and they cleaned up afterwards. Very reasonable price. We will use them again for sure and recommend to anyone who needs tree work done!

reviews.author: David Holland
reviews.text: Did an excellent job removing and trimming trees from around our house. Cleaned up all debris as well. Was a very fair price and were very professional. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Brenda Wallace
reviews.text: We are happy with their professionalism and the quality of their work. They removed 10 trees and ground 2 stumps and you would never know they had been here once they were finished. We definitely recommend Settle Tree Service.

reviews.author: William Lee
reviews.text: I couldn't be more pleased with the quality of work and the professionalism of the Settle Tree Service team. They showed up on time, did exactly what I hired them to do, and gave me the best price of three other competitors. These folks are true pros! Highly recommended! W.D. LEE, VADM, USCG (ret)

reviews.author: Craig Modlin
reviews.text: Called Eric. Needed some giant trees removed near my house. Came by in a few days. Gave me an awesome price and did an excellent job! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Rosie Doch
reviews.text: This company is the best! They came out and removed the trees we wanted, ground the stumps, and when they left you would have never know they were here. They were courteous professionals and we were very happy with their service.

reviews.author: Rebecka Keeter
reviews.text: These guys are fantastic. Quick, careful, accurate estimates, fair prices, prompt. I’ve hired them twice now and been very satisfied both times. Definitely worth it!

reviews.author: Joe Hightower
reviews.text: Great work and careful thorough cleanup. They had a good sized crew with a bucket truck, chipper etc and completed the job in a single morning. Worth the wait to get them!

reviews.author: Cathy Ingram
reviews.text: Totally unrelated to trees however it says EVERYTHING about your employees. I was at Hardees today when my car started overheating and I had pulled over and raised the hood to make sure it wasn't on fire. Two of your employees....not sure of their names, one had great ink,but they actually walked over to help me out. Thanks again guys for giving me hope for humanity even if it does come in slight doses.....YOU GUYS ROCK! If I EVER need a tree company I will call you.

reviews.author: Harry Smith
reviews.text: If you need any type of tree service. This company gets the job done. Professional, on time and a great job.

reviews.author: Stephen Casey
reviews.text: Very satisfied with the overall tree removal service that was completed safely, efficiently, and professionally.

reviews.author: Fin-Attic
reviews.text: Absolutely Happy with Settle Tree Service .Professional Service at a Fair Price. Setting Appointment for Stump Removal . R Renegar

reviews.author: Johnny Peterson
reviews.text: Very Professional...Great Quality Work..Cleaned up the yard when done. Thank you. Johnny Peterson Newport

reviews.author: Heathersoul
reviews.text: Excellent job done! I'll use Settle again. Took down the tree, ground the stump and cleaned up everything.

reviews.author: James East
reviews.text: Excellent work, very professional, really nice and good group of guys!! Thanks for a job well done!!

reviews.author: James Reese Morton
reviews.text: Great service and the employees work very hard and go above and beyond to make sure the job is done correctly. I will use there services again’

reviews.author: Michael D'Andrea
reviews.text: The Settle Tree Service three man team brought their A-Game to do windstorm damage clean-up. One 35 foot Hickory uprooted on its side, 20 foot Branch on the house. They have all right heavy equipment and take away capability to get the job done. Great Price, Professional and courteous work right down to picking up the small sticks. HIGHLY Recommend. Mike in Cedar Point NC
